name: David Jones and the King Bees

podcast.title: First Record Appearance (1964)
podcast.body: This group, featuring David Jones (later David Bowie), made his first ever appearance on record on June 5th, 1964. "The group was David Jones and the King Bees. That's the first time David Bowie ever appeared on record."
